packageRules.description: Shipwright's own GHCR service images are bumped by auto-bump-chart.yml, not Renovate
Group routine (non-security) minor/patch bumps to cut down PR noise
zod 4 and @hono/zod-openapi 1.x are a coupled pair (zod-to-openapi 9 requires zod ^4); keep their updates, including majors, in one PR
Track the claude-code CLI's stable channel (not latest) in its own PR; declared after the routine grouping rule so it is not folded into it. Schedule is inherited (Monday).

The App Vitals agent platform packages (@app-vitals/agent-*) release together; bump them in one PR, majors included, with exact pins. Fallback for .github/workflows/platform-release.yml, which bumps them on each platform release dispatch. Declared after the routine grouping rule so it is not folded into it. The platform-cutover label lets the PR through platform-freeze-guard.yml (admin/package.json is a frozen path until AGR-4.4).

customManagers.description: Bump the pinned claude-code CLI via the annotated ARG CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION line in agent/Dockerfile
